entries.reason: LaunchGate is the synchronous pre-actor admission boundary for cancellation-storm warmups. Its immutable capacity and bounded claim dictionary are accessed only while one private NSLock is held; keys and tokens are Sendable values, and the actor revalidates every claim before creating work. Keeping this helper synchronous prevents unbounded Task creation before actor deduplication.

The adaptive cancellation controller is called synchronously from unrelated tasks and cannot become an actor without changing admission latency and call semantics. Its only mutable dictionary is bounded and every read, trim, cancellation observation and ticket update is linearized by one private NSLock atomic helper.

AnimationFrameMemory is the synchronous decoded-frame hot path shared by independent playback sessions. Its only mutable state is the private FoveaCompactSieveCache, whose slot graph, index, cost and SIEVE metadata are already linearized by one audited NSLock; this wrapper stores an immutable cost limit and delegates every read, insert and removal to that cache. Actor isolation would add a hop to each display tick and would not strengthen the underlying synchronization boundary.

DerivedRasterPublicationLease is the synchronous publication fence shared by cancellation or namespace revocation and an asynchronous persistence adapter. One private NSLock protects the single Boolean permission bit; close is monotone, every read is serialized, and the lease stores no task, request, container, record or store reference. Synchronous close is required so publication permission is revoked before task cancellation or awaiting background work.

DerivedRasterDirectChunkSource is a synchronous CoreGraphics data-provider bridge that may receive concurrent positional reads. The compressed surface is immutable; one private NSLock protects only the optional immutable decoded-chunk memo and its index. Decompression and caller buffer copies run outside the lock, while every cache publication, lookup and clear is serialized.

FetchCancellationHandoffLease carries an activated cancellation grace plus attempt-local progress metadata between a task-local operation, transport progress callback and cancellation handler that may run concurrently. One private NSLock serializes activation, response-attempt reset, cumulative-byte updates and eligibility reads. The lease stores only scalar counts and capability flags, never a request, transport, task or continuation reference; unknown or incomparable progress fails closed, and activation remains monotone.

The Fovea-owned compact SIEVE index is synchronously shared by transport handoff operations after the external Akashic boundary is enforced. Every mutable slot, key index, free-list, SIEVE hand, epoch and cost counter is accessed only through one private NSLock-backed atomic helper; generic keys and values are constrained to Sendable, while actor isolation would change the synchronous cache hot path.

entries.reason: AsyncThrowingStream termination and the producer task may race while deciding whether cancellation diagnostics are emitted. The helper contains only two Boolean fields and all compound observations and transitions are serialized by a private NSLock; no reference to mutable pipeline state is stored.

The H013 progressive resource recorder is a bounded diagnostic-only synchronization boundary: all mutable owner maps, barrier state, sequence counters and samples are protected by one private NSLock, while the injected footprint providers are Sendable closures. The preparation resource lease has a separate private lock protecting its one monotone released bit so converging decode, discard and cancellation paths can end recorder ownership exactly once.

PipelineProgressiveObservationState is a minimal synchronous bridge used by progress callbacks and response finalization to agree whether this subscriber observed progress. Its only mutable field is one Boolean, and both mutation and observation are serialized by the same private NSLock-backed withLock operation; it stores no pipeline, task, continuation or decoder reference.

TransportProgressRelay is the synchronous linearization boundary between transport progress callbacks and one asynchronous progressive consumer. One private NSLock protects its bounded buffer, waiter and terminal state; the relay enforces one consumer, and continuations are resumed only after the protected state transition has been decided.

DefaultRenderedImageCache is the synchronous rendered-image hot path. Its probation, large-probation, main shards and identity governor are independently lock-protected cache primitives, while one coordination NSLock serializes the only wrapper-owned mutable cross-tier budget owner and compound promotion, removal and trim transitions. The resident payload and keys are Sendable values, and the cache concurrency tests exercise mixed parallel access.

The transient handoff store coordinates asynchronous file preparation with synchronous bounded-index publication. Invalidated state and in-flight counters are protected by stateLock, the index has its own audited lock, and blocking filesystem work is isolated on DispatchWorkExecutor; no mutable field is accessed outside its owning synchronization boundary.

ValidatedOriginalResumeCapture bridges synchronous transport progress callbacks with later candidate extraction. Its seed and byte limits are immutable, and one private NSLock serializes the complete optional State machine including response reset, bounded prefix append, completion and candidate snapshot. Invalid cumulative counts or bounds fail closed by clearing state rather than publishing partial mutable data.

MultipartJPEGProgressRelay is the synchronous linearization boundary between URLSession progress callbacks and one bounded AsyncThrowingStream consumer. One private NSLock protects the parser, continuation and terminal bit; decoder transitions happen while locked, continuations are yielded or finished only after unlocking, and a full buffer fails closed instead of silently dropping an animation frame.

MultipartJPEGTransportOwner synchronizes explicit session cancellation, AsyncThrowingStream termination, transport task installation and normal task completion. One private NSLock protects the only mutable task, subscription and monotone cancellation fields; task and stream cancellation occur after unlocking, so callbacks cannot re-enter the ownership critical section or double-cancel resources.

A staged body lease can be read, cloned and released by different subscribers. The ownership bit and all file operations that depend on it are serialized by one private NSLock; deinitialization atomically claims deletion before touching the filesystem, while the immutable session lease keeps the directory alive.

entries.reason: URLSessionTaskLifetime reconciles registration completion, cancellation and normal finish callbacks that may race outside the transport actor. The task, router and priority task references are immutable; one private NSLock protects the three monotone lifecycle flags, and cancellation or router unregistration happens only after unlocking so callbacks cannot re-enter the critical section or unregister twice.

The two synchronous helpers expose only bounded metadata beside the actor-isolated Akashic derived-raster store. DerivedRasterRecentAccessIndex protects its String set with one private NSLock for insert, remove and atomic consume; DerivedRasterPartitionCache protects a capacity-bounded fingerprint-to-partition dictionary with its own private NSLock. Neither helper owns blob bytes, filesystem state or mutable actor state.

DerivedRasterRecordLookupIndex is a read-optimized snapshot beside the actor-owned durable record store. One private NSLock protects the immutable-record dictionary and mutationInProgress fence; reads fail closed while a persistent mutation is active, replacement constructs validated digest snapshots outside the lock and publishes them atomically, and no filesystem mutation occurs through this helper.

RepresentationRecordExactLookupIndex is a synchronous read-only acceleration snapshot beside the actor-isolated durable Vary store. One private NSLock protects the grouped immutable record arrays and mutationInProgress fence; exact lookups fail closed during mutation, and replaceAll builds and sorts the next snapshot off-lock before one atomic publication. It cannot write manifests or bypass namespace checks.

FoveaSwiftUIVisibilitySequencer serializes visibility operations onto MainActor while allowing synchronous submission from lifecycle callbacks. One private NSLock protects the sole mutable tail Task reference; each replacement captures the previous Sendable task, cancels it after creating the ordered successor, and cancel removes the tail under lock before cancellation. UI mutation remains confined to the supplied MainActor operation.

FoveaLifecycleNotificationMonitor performs synchronous NotificationCenter registration before the system composition root returns, preventing an immediate background notification from being missed. Its opaque Objective-C token array is immutable after initialization, callbacks capture only the Sendable animation runtime weakly, and deinit is the sole token consumer; there is no concurrently mutable state to isolate with an actor or lock.
